statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code I48.0 was submitted
The diagnosis code G45.9 was submitted
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
